## 5. Example `admin/main.tf` (harness, no human auth)

```hcl
# Generated by vault-brownfield-codifier
# Capability: admin-config
# Doc ref: https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/docs

terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.9"

  required_providers {
    vault = {
      source  = "hashicorp/vault"
      version = "~> 4"
    }
  }
}

provider "vault" {
  address          = var.vault_address
  skip_child_token = true
}

provider "vault" {
  alias            = "admin"
  address          = var.vault_address
  namespace        = "admin"
  skip_child_token = true
}

locals {
  operator_policies = [
    vault_policy.admin_admin.name,
    vault_policy.admin_namespace_admin.name,
  ]
}
```

(`vault_namespace.admin` and `vault_policy.*` are declared by their owning
skills in the same layer.)
